rules.title: Required project structure exists
rules.description: The Xcode project, pubspec.yaml, and Info.plist must exist locally for the app to be considered technically complete for review.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local project files, never inferred.

rules.title: Version and build number exist and parse
rules.description: A parseable X.Y.Z+N Flutter version/build is required for a complete, reviewable submission.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local project files, never inferred.

rules.title: Possible placeholder markers in local docs/config
rules.description: Broad local documentation/config text is scanned for placeholder markers (TODO, TBD, lorem ipsum, etc.). This is advisory only: the location scanned is not proven to be review-facing.
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Usage-description keys required by detected permission-using dependencies
rules.description: When a pubspec.yaml dependency that is known to require a specific Info.plist usage-description key is present, that key must exist locally with a non-empty value.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when both the dependency line and the missing/empty key are directly parsed; never inferred from prose.

rules.title: App display-name candidate exists
rules.description: A non-empty, resolved local display-name candidate must exist.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local project files, never inferred.

rules.title: Version/build is coherent for App Store metadata
rules.description: The same local version/build evidence used for technical completeness must also be coherent as review-facing metadata.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local project files, never inferred.

rules.title: Privacy-policy URL candidate
rules.description: A local privacy-policy URL candidate is looked for; its absence is UNKNOWN, never fabricated or assumed missing-and-blocking.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when a candidate is found locally; UNKNOWN otherwise, never inferred.

rules.title: Support URL candidate
rules.description: A local support URL candidate is looked for; its absence is UNKNOWN, never fabricated or assumed missing-and-blocking.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when a candidate is found locally; UNKNOWN otherwise, never inferred.

rules.title: Placeholder content in an exact review-facing field
rules.description: Only the exact display-name and pubspec description fields are checked. A match here is proof, not a guess, so it may BLOCK.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: the exact review-facing field content is matched directly, never guessed.

rules.title: Localization structure consistency
rules.description: Bridges the existing readiness localization-directory finding; informational only, never blocking.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local project files, never inferred.

rules.title: Possible login/account requirement
rules.description: Detects possible login/authentication code via a conservative text scan. A match is a heuristic signal, not proof, so it may never BLOCK by itself.
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Demo/review-account evidence when login is required
rules.description: When login is detected and no demo/review-account documentation or notes candidate exists locally, review access is proven missing. Apple requires full access for account-based apps.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when the underlying evidence (login match plus absence of any review-access text) is directly parsed; never fabricated.

rules.title: Review-notes candidate
rules.description: Informational only: whether local text resembling review notes/instructions was found. Absence is UNKNOWN (ASC-side notes are not queried), never blocking.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when found locally; UNKNOWN otherwise, never inferred.

rules.title: Backend/API endpoint dependency
rules.description: A local URL/endpoint reference proves a backend dependency exists; it never proves the backend is reachable, so this rule can be ADVISORY at most, never PASS from local evidence alone.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH that a reference exists when found; availability itself is never claimed from local evidence.

rules.title: Permission usage-description presence
rules.description: Bridges the existing readiness permissions finding. A usage-description key's presence is evidence of a declared permission only; it never implies what data is collected or how it is used.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when a plist key is found; UNKNOWN when only heuristic code text is found, never inferred as data collection.

rules.title: App Privacy (nutrition label) publication status
rules.description: Whether App Privacy details were published in App Store Connect cannot be determined from a local project. This is always UNKNOWN unless an explicit local attestation file is present; it is never fabricated or automated.
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when an explicit local attestation file is present; UNKNOWN otherwise, never inferred or automated.

future_sources.note: Reserved for a future HIG visual-review phase. No active Phase 3 rule references this source; touch-target sizing and other visual checks are out of scope until deterministic evidence for them exists.
